# Chennai Central Warrenville

> Authentic South Indian Cuisine in Warrenville, Illinois

## Overview
Chennai Central Warrenville is a fine South Indian restaurant located at 28331 Dodge Dr, Warrenville, IL 60555. The menu features traditional South Indian specialties including Dum Biryani, Masala Dosa, Chettinad curries, Chicken 65, Idly & Sambar, and Madras Filter Coffee.

## Key Information
- Address: 28331 Dodge Dr, Warrenville, IL 60555
- Phone: (630) 393-6570
- Cuisine: Authentic South Indian
- Services: Lunch, Dinner, Dine-In, Takeout, Banquet & Catering
- Price Range: $$
